questions.question: Which approach reflects the expected standard for handling confidential information?
questions.options: Share information only with colleagues who may need it for related business activities |Keep confidential information secure and treat its protection as a professional responsibility |Discuss confidential information only in private areas, while retaining copies for future reference |Use professional judgement to determine when confidential information can be shared if it supports business objectives

questions.question: Which behaviour demonstrates effective listening during a conversation with a healthcare customer?
questions.options: Waiting for an appropriate pause before connecting the customer’s comments to relevant information  |Focusing on the customer’s responses while identifying opportunities to transition naturally into the product discussion|Listening for specific needs, asking relevant follow-up questions and remembering information that can inform future interactions  |Taking detailed notes throughout the conversation so that every point raised by the customer can be addressed later
